title: Machine for Writing a Record Template
statement: For finite decidable types $Q,T$, there are a natural number $K$, a finite decidable state type $P$, a deterministic machine $R$ with $K+2$ work tapes over the record alphabet, entry and exit states, and a constant $C$ such that the following holds. For every binary string $x$, natural number $s$, and binary string $w$ representing $s$ in base two, any configuration $d$ on the embedded input with entry state and input head at position $1$, with tape $1$ containing $w$, tape $0$ blank over the joined template interval, and every tape of index at least $2$ blank, reaches in at most $C(|\langle H\rangle|+|w|+|x|+1)$ steps the configuration obtained by entering the exit state and writing the joined fields of the prescribed record template $H$ for parameters $Q,T,|x|,s$ on tape $0$. It avoids the exit state before that time, and all work-tape heads stay within distance $C(|\langle H\rangle|+|w|+1)$ of their starting positions through that time.
hypotheses_covered: Natural number $s$ and binary representation $w$ with $\operatorname{ofDigits}_2(w)=s$
Entry state and input head at position $1$
Tape $0$ is blank throughout the template interval
All tapes of index at least $2$ are blank
